annotations.title: Get Dedicated Server Plan Change Options

description: List available dedicated-server IP plan-change options and constraints for a service. Hardware changes are not supported. Use preview_dedicated_plan_change for the full change overview with pricing before applying.

serviceId.description: ID of the Dedicated server: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_dedicated_servers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.
